extraction.Name: Rose LaPointe Good Eagle
extraction.Refused/Protested: Not just at that time but I did after wards. I had Reverend Barker wrute ti Congressman Williamson inquiring whether the patent could be cancelled or whether I could get the taxes I paid refunded. The Congressman answered that it was impossible to do either as it had been issued and it was mine, I was a citizen. I have the letter at home.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I sold it after I received the information that I could not have the patent cancelled or the taxes refunded. I sold 40 acres at a time the first in 1925 the second in February 1926, the third in June 1926 and the last 40 in November 1926.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I should like to have those taxes amounting to something more than $300 refunded to me and then I would be satisfied with the whole deal.
extraction.NOTES: Received patent through the mail while at home. Got $3650.00 for the land. Has one child, 9 years old. In good health. Did not ask for the patent. Paid taxes of more than $300 and sought to have them refunded or patent cancelled; Congressman Williamson responded that neither was possible. Subscribed and sworn before notary April 26, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32.
